# Participant Characteristics

## Age and Gender

### Age distribution

```{r age_group, include = F}
# Count age group and arrange
df <- df %>% 
  mutate(
    age_group = factor(
      age_group,
      levels = c("<30", "30-39", "40-49", "50-59", ">=60")
    )
  )

# Calculate age groups
age_group_bar <- df %>% 
  count(age_group) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(
    x = age_group,
    y = n,
    fill = age_group
  )) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = paste0("n = ", n)),
    vjust = 1.5,
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "YlOrRd") +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Age Groups",
    x = "Age Group",
    y = "Number of Surgeons"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  )

age_group_bar
```
